s: The article details a method for improving LLM prompts, specifically for API syntax templates, by feeding log files to the LLM and refining the system prompt with examples and comments. It also explores integrating LLM-triggered CRUD operations with HTMX for real-time UI updates.
sub: LLM Prompt Engineering with Log Data
Refining API Syntax Templates with Examples
Integrating LLM CRUD Operations with HTMX for UI Updates
Dynamic System Prompt Updates for LLMs
